description: This is a Go test source file containing integration tests for block operations in the Focalboard server, including creating, updating, deleting, and undeleting blocks.

methods.name: TestGetBlocks
methods.description: Tests retrieving blocks for a board.

methods.name: TestPostBlock
methods.description: Tests inserting new blocks, including creating single and multiple blocks, and attempting to update a block via insert endpoint.

methods.name: TestPatchBlock
methods.description: Tests patching (updating) block fields, including title and custom fields, and removing fields.

methods.name: TestUndeleteBlock
methods.description: Tests undeleting a previously deleted block, including permission checks.
